protocol: The central receiver robot broadcasts in round-robin order; a neighbor returns a transmission after detecting a packet intended for itself. Each file logs incoming CSI at the named endpoint, regardless of tx/rx in its filename. Common frame counter joins a forward and a reply record from the same ranked peer/run. It identifies a reciprocal exchange, not two observations of the same one-way packet. Use labels from config_files/dataset.json.
measures: Runs grouped by condition directory and shared filename acquisition key, direction by sender label inside each receiver capture. Integer Unix seconds and microseconds from CSI header; strictly increasing within each run/direction. No local frame counter repeated. Median/max intervals are between local logged arrivals. Unseen at both counts IDs in the intersection of the two observed counter spans that occur in neither log; boundaries outside this span are not imputed. Source-side send events and radio loss are not guaranteed by an absent CSI log. Blank columns mean no corresponding file, not 0 arrivals. The 49 extra link-runs are central evidence for tx2 in NLOS Set C without tx2 files.
clock_boundary: Across 637 matches at the link/run level, medians of (peer receive clock - central receive clock) for same-index exchanges run from -323833 to +57777931 microseconds. Differences include host clock offset and reciprocal direction ordering. They are not estimates of one-way latency, RTT or controller adoption. No globally synchronized event time or per-transmission ground-truth denominator is asserted.
independent_audit: A separate NumPy fixed-stride decode verified length/code (0x00e7 / 187), 233-byte record counts, microseconds range and truncated-byte counts for every single file. Full per-file hashes and shape are retained.
reproduce: Python 3 standard library. python derive_wsr.py DATASET_CHECKOUT OUTPUT_DIRECTORY. Expected Dataset/2D-Displacement_raw_data and config_files/dataset.json under DATASET_CHECKOUT.
